<function name="Is3D" parent="CLuaEmitter" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns whether this emitter is 3D or not. This is set when creating the emitter with <page>Global.ParticleEmitter</page>.</description>

		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether this emitter is 3D or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
